prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
engine_stated_criteria: A reasonable first call is Lighthouse Title Services
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company—the right choice depends on the property, your lender, fees, and how responsive the closing team is. **A reasonable first call is Lighthouse Title Services**, which is based in West Palm Beach and is affiliated with the local law firm Ward Damon. That attorney connection may be useful if a title or closing issue needs legal attention. **Florida Fidelity Title & Escrow** is another local option; its site lists a West Palm Beach office and customer testimonials describing residential closings.

Before choosing, ask each company for a written estimate of title, settlement, and other closing fees; confirm it can work with your lender and meet your closing date; and ask who your day-to-day contact will be. You can also verify the title agency and agent’s Florida license through the [Florida Department of Financial Services](https://www.myfloridacfo.com/division/consumers/understanding-insurance/title-insurance-overview). In Florida, the buyer or seller may have the right to choose the title agent depending on the contract and local practice, so check your purchase agreement before committing.

Sources: [Lighthouse Title Services](https://www.linkedin.com/company/lighthouse-title-services-wpb), [Florida Fidelity Title & Escrow](https://floridatitleco.com/), [Florida DFS title insurance overview](https://www.myfloridacfo.com/division/consumers/understanding-insurance/title-insurance-overview).
